title: Map each Effect and the track filter to its device, with located warnings for what has no equal
description:
## Intent

Each effect becomes its device, in order.

## Steps

- `crates/apricity-daw/src/devices/map.rs`: `Effect` variants (`crates/apricity-score/src/score.rs`: `Eq`, `Comp`, `Limit`, `Drive`, `Lofi`, `NoiseGate`, `Width`, `Reverb`, `Delay`) to devices per the mapping table; track `filter` (`FilterSpec`, 12 dB/oct) as an Auto Filter first in the chain; default wet shares as `docs/language.md` states (25% on tracks and groups, 100% on returns).
- Settings with no equal: left out or approximated per `design/daw-set.md`, each a warning located by the effect's path (`tracks[i].effects[j]`, mapped to the `.apr` line through the DSL source map when available).

## Verification

`CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-daw --test daw` — "Effects become stock devices" and "Settings with no stock equal are reported" pass.

## Release

`feat(<this task's id>): effects as stock devices in DAW sets`. Not breaking.
